summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by handling multiplication of a Point with a scalar, but it may not cover all edge cases and could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The patch assumes that the multiplication will always involve a Point, which might not be true for all cases. It should handle scenarios where the multiplication involves non-Point objects more gracefully.
The patch could be made more readable by extracting the logic into a separate function or adding comments to explain the purpose of the added code.
